## Summary
- generate a stable, human-readable taxonomy reference from taxonomy-data.js
- keep the generated reference current with a versioned pre-commit hook and CI verification
- install repository hooks through the npm prepare lifecycle and document the local workflow

## Validation
- node tools/validate-taxonomy.mjs
- node tools/generate-taxonomy-markdown.mjs --verify
- node --test tools/validate-taxonomy.test.mjs tools/generate-taxonomy-markdown.test.mjs
